notes: This is the public disclosure-safe research queue. Complete internal research prompts are retained in verified private storage.
Queue items are research prompts without execution authority.
Only public-source research is admissible here; confidential AXIOM state, security detail, customer data, and proprietary methodology must remain private.
ISSUED means a prompt was prepared for manual submission; it does not establish delivery or execution.
Automation must pass publication screening, exact-head validation, and existing authorization boundaries before acceptance.
